Targeted pass of a 1233-page BREF (JRC107041). Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 52). Main file: per-route energy and CO2/PFC from the 'current consumption and emission levels' sections of each metal chapter: copper (Sect. 3.2.1 route energy 14-20 GJ/t, electrorefining, Tables 3.28-3.37 furnace operating data, KRS/anode furnace flows, secondary smelter and semis plant), aluminium (Table 4.5 Bayer refinery 7.6-11.7 GJ/t, tube vs traditional digestion, Alunorte CFB calciner 2.79 GJ/t, anode baking 2000-2400 MJ/t, Table 4.9 prebake/Soderberg kWh/kg, 53-61 GJ/t, CO2 1.4-1.7 t/t, PFC 0.01-0.1 kg/t, casthouse/homogenising Table 4.10, secondary Al 2-9 GJ/t and Table 4.28 furnace types), lead (Table 5.9 and plant balances Tables 5.5-5.7 with derived per-t values), zinc (Table 6.8, Table 6.18 hydro/hydro+pyro/ISF MJ/t, Waelz/SDHL, plasma fuming), ferro-alloys (Tables 8.5-8.10 electricity, reductant potential energy and total energy per t alloy; CO2 Table 8.18-8.22), nickel (Sect. 9.2.1 and plant A/C/E), carbon and graphite (Sect. 10.2), emerging techniques (state rows), and Annex 13.3 whole-plant investment costs (copper smelters, refineries, wire rod, secondary Cu; primary Al greenfield PFPB and conversions, opex; secondary Al rotary furnace; lead, zinc, ISF and residue plants). _flows: reductant, fuel oil, oxygen, gas and raw material per t (kg converted to t with formula). _measures: Chapter 2 and metal-chapter energy techniques with savings or costs (regenerative burners, charge preheating, oxy-fuel, liquid metal delivery, EM pumping, ferro-alloy energy recovery). Not loaded: BAT-AELs and all non-GHG pollutant data, dust, water, noise, abatement-equipment costs (gas treatment centres, scrubbers, ESPs, acid plants), precious metals chapter (no route energy data), BAT conclusions chapter. Traps: Tables 4.28, 5.9, 6.8, 6.18, 8.5, 8.8 and 8.18 have garbled text layers and were read from rendered page images. Copper annex costs were converted by the source from USD at EUR 1 = USD 1.06 (June 1999); they are loaded as original-year USD by reversing that printed factor. Lead/zinc annex tables (Kruger 1999) print EUR in headers while the text says USD: loaded as printed EUR, flagged. Ferro-alloy 'potential energy by using coke' is the latent energy of the carbon reductant (7.7 kWh/kg coke) and is loaded as a coke/coal SEC row; totals = electricity + reductant. Specific-energy rows for total energy use a blank target. PFC loaded with target 'pfc' (mass of CF4+C2F6, not CO2e). QSL electricity (9 000 000 MWh/yr) and FeNi CO2 (45 000 kg/t) look misprinted; zinc roaster recovery '3.5 MJ/t Zn' kept only in other-values. Rows tagged [total-electrical] or [incl-fesicr] are second cases of the same example.
